questions.q: What did Jacob tell his household before going up to Bethel?
choices: Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean
questions.explain: The strange gods were Laban's images that Rachel had stolen and hidden.

questions.q: Why did the cities round about not pursue the sons of Jacob after Shechem?
choices: They were at war with Egypt
The terror of God was upon them
questions.explain: The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear Him (Psalms 34:7).

questions.q: What did God promise would come out of Israel's loins?
choices: A nation, a company of nations, and kings
questions.explain: Christ hath made us kings and priests unto God (Revelation 1:5-6).
Rachel called him Benoni as she died; his father called him Benjamin, the twelfth son.

questions.q: Why did Reuben lose the birthright?
choices: He refused to go to Egypt
He defiled his father's bed with Bilhah
questions.explain: His birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph (1 Chronicles 5:1).
